description: Sync BMad epics to GitHub: creates milestones labels and issues from epics.md. Run after sprint planning and re-run whenever epics change.

Pick the next story from GitHub (or use the current story worktree), claim its issue, create or reuse a git worktree, run bmad-build to plan implement and review it, then push and open a PR that closes the issue.

Push a story branch and open or update its PR: Closes the story issue, shares labels with it, and moves it to status:review. Story Build runs this for you; run it yourself from a story worktree you finished by hand.
Optional extra review of an open story PR with bmad-code-review; pushes fixes to the PR. Never marks the story done — merging the PR does.
Run on main after a story PR is merged: marks the story done in sprint-status.yaml and GitHub; cleans up its worktree and branch. Idempotent with the CI workflow.
Install the BMAD Story Sync GitHub Actions workflow: does the same writes as Story Sync automatically when a PR closes its issue.
